deep_analysis:
3 open trades, all long, all flat-to-positive (+$0.70 unrealized). Portfolio health CRITICAL is driven by the trailing 24h closed set, not by the open book.

OPEN TRADES — would I open these fresh today?
1. BTC LONG (continuum-trend+, opened 05:45, +0.00%): thesis partially valid — BTC has been above EMA300 for ~9h (557+ min), LEAN_BULL on 1m, 15m regime LONG_BIAS. BUT meta_rsi at entry was 11.08 (extreme oversold) and 4h regime is SHORT_BIAS with trend_quality STRONG_DOWN — this is a counter-trend scalper inside a 4h downtrend. Fresh today: marginal yes on 15m/continuum alignment, no on 4h. Hold with tight management; SL at 82654 (-1.08%) is reasonable for current low volatility.
2. ETH LONG (hl_copy_trader, 2h, +0.66%): entry at meta_rsi 56.4 — center band, clean. Stop already at 2518.2, ABOVE entry 2510.6 — breakeven locked (+0.3%). Regime LONG_BIAS conf 56.9. Keep. Would open fresh.
3. LDO LONG (pump-chain+, 3h, +2.57%): entry meta_rsi 56.9, up 2.57%. Stop already at 0.41447 vs entry 0.40645 — locks +1.97% profit. Trail engine in control. Keep. Would open fresh. Only concern: LDO 5m regime is NEUTRAL ranging (slope ~0), so momentum has stalled — trail will either ride the next leg or exit at locked profit. No action needed.

PATTERN (verified from PostgreSQL, last 24h, n=18 closed, W4/L12, net -$1.09):
The book is losing from BOTH RSI extremes, not from the middle:
- LONG meta_rsi <45: n=4, 0% WR, -$0.38. All oversold-bounce+ (PUMP 44.2, APT 41.7, NEAR 37.2) plus ICP pump-chain 41.4. All exit=hard_max_loss. These were falling-knife longs — the WINNING side was the SHORT (or simply standing aside). We bought into dumps.
- LONG meta_rsi 70+: n=5, 20% WR, -$0.39. GRASS 72.8, BABY 75.0, KAS 71.6, HYPE 76.6 all lost; only ALT 73.7 won. pump-chain+ chasing after the pump. The WINNING side was already held by early longs — we arrived late and bought their exit liquidity.
- LONG meta_rsi 45-70: n=7, mostly small. The only structurally winning band 60-70 went 3/4 but PnL still ~flat because winners were tiny.
- 9 of 12 losses exit=hard_max_loss: chop/wrong-side entries that never reached +0.40% for trail to arm. Classic hard_max_loss 0%-WR chop family.

Bottom line: we are entering at the extremes (too late on pumps, too early on dumps) instead of at the mid-band where both the oscillator and the trail system work. Every one of those losers had a winning counterpart on the other side.

SIGNAL HEALTH: pump-chain+ 7 trades 24h, 2W/5L (-$0.33) — its edge has collapsed at RSI>70 (chase zone). oversold-bounce+ 3/3 losses 24h, -$0.33 — every entry was RSI 37-44 knife-catch. Both are bleeding money on their current entry-RSI profiles. This is signal-tuning territory (brain auditor), not watchdog territory — flagging only.

Correlation: 3 longs are BTC/ETH/beta-LDO — one BTC dump hits all three. Acceptable at LOW volatility with 2 stops already profit-locked, but do NOT add a 4th correlated long unless BTC breaks 4h SHORT_BIAS.
regime_context:
BTC is in a split regime: 15m LONG_BIAS and continuum ABOVE EMA300 for ~9h (LEAN_BULL, recovery phase), but 4h remains SHORT_BIAS with trend_quality STRONG_DOWN and volatility LOW (velocity SLOW, acceleration mostly NEGATIVE, volume LOW). Wyckoff: ACCUMULATION on 1m. regime_5m scan: BTC NEUTRAL ranging; aggregate market LONG_BIAS 42 vs 5 short.

What this means for positions: our 3 longs align with the 15m/continuum recovery and are correctly placed for a bounce. They are counter-trend to the 4h down — fine for scalps with hard stops, wrong for swing holds. Do not add size against the 4h. If BTC loses the EMA300 (~83000) the whole long book stops out together; that is the cluster risk. Conversely the 4h SHORT_BIAS in an accumulation phase with alts grinding up (PURR +4%, PONS +2.4%, ALT +3.2%) looks like a stale short signal — the winning side right now is LONG alts on the 15m, which is what we hold.
